limitations: Matched shared-host uninstrumented complete batches; one warmup and three alternating measured pairs per workload.
Human chromosome 22 only; all 30 original seeds, K64 and 30 iterations retained.
RSS sampled at 20ms (human) or 10ms (synthetic), lower bound on peak live-process RSS; excludes controller.
C outputs are retained hash-verified canonical references. C timings are not rerun in this campaign.
Synthetic original/model-based batches retain respectively three/one nonfinite reference controls.

worker_selection.selection: Lowest mean of baseline and candidate screen wall times; identical affinity/workers used in fresh paired confirmation.

unsplit.scope: Single full unsplit chromosome correctness control; not a repeated speed estimate.
